items.caption:
In the EU, Oct 25 lasts 25 hours.
In Central Europe the clocks go from 3:00 back to 2:00 that night (UK 2:00 to 1:00, Eastern Europe 4:00 to 3:00; US and Canada change on Nov 1). A 2013 review found little sign of extra sleep that night, and earlier wake-ups for about five days after.
